title: afla-cftr-ont
description: CFTR analysis of targeted Nanopore data: read alignment, small variants with read-based phasing, poly-T/TG, exon deletions and duplications, optional Ensembl VEP and ClinVar annotation, and a one-page report per sample with CFTR2 classes. Education and research use only, not for clinical use.

resources.run_time: A CFTR panel run: about 10-30 minutes.

input.title: Input
input.description: Reads for all samples of the run.

fastq.title: FASTQ folder
fastq.description: Folder of basecalled reads: one sub-folder per sample (MinKNOW barcode folders, or AFLA Demux output), or one <sample>.fastq.gz per sample. Unclassified reads are ignored.
fastq.help_text: Include at least 4 samples from the run: exon deletions and duplications are found by comparing samples with each other.

ref.title: Reference genome (FASTA)
ref.description: GRCh38 reference FASTA with chr names (chr7).
ref.help_text: bwa index files (.amb .ann .bwt .pac .sa) should sit next to it. The .fai and .dict files are made automatically if missing.

bed.title: Target regions (optional)
bed.description: BED file of the regions your panel targets. Variants are called there. If empty, all CFTR exons +/-25 bases and selected deep intronic sites are used. Coverage is always judged against that CFTR list.

cftr2_list.title: CFTR2 variant list
cftr2_list.description: CFTR2 variant list (.xlsx, downloaded from cftr2.org after accepting its usage agreement). Used to classify variants; without it the report says so.

ont_caller.title: Variant caller
ont_caller.description: Use bcftools. Clair3 is experimental: in testing on a real amplicon sample it missed F508del, although almost half of the reads carried it.

bcftools_profile.title: bcftools Nanopore profile
bcftools_profile.description: ont-sup-1.20 for recent super-accuracy basecalling; ont for older or faster basecalling.

clair3_model.title: Clair3 model
clair3_model.description: Used only with the Clair3 caller. The two R10.4.1 models in this Clair3 image, for super-accuracy basecalling: v500 for recent basecallers, v410 for older ones.

run_phasing.title: Phase variants (WhatsHap)
run_phasing.description: Uses reads to place heterozygous variants on the same or opposite chromosomes, where the same reads join them.

annotation.title: Annotation sources
annotation.description: Local files, so annotation works offline. Leave optional sources empty to skip them.

run_annotation.title: 5. Annotate variants (Ensembl VEP)
run_annotation.description: Adds gene, consequence, HGVS, gnomAD frequency, ClinVar, REVEL and AlphaMissense (sources set below).

vep_cache.title: VEP cache folder
vep_cache.description: Folder that contains homo_sapiens/<version>_GRCh38 (the offline Ensembl cache; includes gnomAD v4.1 frequencies).

vep_cache_version.title: VEP cache version
vep_cache_version.description: Must match the cache folder and the VEP container (115).

clinvar_vcf.title: ClinVar VCF (optional)
clinvar_vcf.description: clinvar_GRCh38.vcf.gz with its .tbi index (monthly releases from NCBI). Choose the data file itself (if you pick its .fai/.tbi index by mistake, the workflow uses the file next to it).

report_min_depth.title: Minimum depth
report_min_depth.description: A target with bases below this depth is flagged in red as a gap in the report.

threads.title: CPU threads
threads.description: Maximum CPU threads for the heavy steps (alignment, calling, annotation).
